package.name: autoware_shoulder_pullover_manager
package.description: Fills Autoware's reserved-but-unimplemented "pull_over" MRM extension point (see /system/mrm/pull_over_manager/{operate,status}, already wired as a client by autoware_mrm_handler but never served). Scores candidate goals along the live shoulder_centerline_path_map, then plans its own standalone, collision-checked trajectory directly to the goal -- Autoware's mission_planner cannot route there since the target shoulder area has no Lanelet2 representation in this project's map at all. A raw-terminal 'P' keypress is provided as a stand-in trigger until a real MRM/diagnostics-driven trigger is wired up.
